text:
alex: Morning — quick release-train check. Canary p95 for model-service spiked to ~1.2s and we're seeing intermittent 503s since 07:20. No rollout blocks yet but I'd like infra to glance. I also put a rollback plan in the ticket just in case. @jamie @devops-bot :eyes:

jamie: On it. Which service and pods? Any recent deploys that line up with the spike?

alex: Mostly backend-model-svc-7c9f. Logs point to upstream timeouts to gpu-proxy:504. There was a small qcache tweak merged ~06:58 that touched KV cache behavior.

sam: FYI I pushed PR #1287 (batching/window tweak) this morning — should reduce tail times for long seqs. Tagging for review, might help p95 if batching mismatch is contributing. cc @rachel

rachel: Reviewing #1287 now. If change is tiny we can merge to canary after a quick perf run.

priya: I cherry-picked the hotfix for issue 432 into release/v1.4.1 and pushed the branch. CI green. Requesting a quick approval and manual smoke on canary.

devops-bot: Canary deploy event: release/v1.4.1 -> canary-cluster (3/3 pods). Health checks: 3/3 passing. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/v1.4.1/canary

alex: Thanks. If infra confirms gpu-proxy pressure, scale or revert the qcache tweak as option A/B. I'm standing by to flip the rollout if error rate climbs. :thumbsup:

jamie: Scaling gpu-proxy by +2 replicas now. Should be up in ~90s. I'll also tail the proxy logs for socket errors.

alex: Update: new replicas came up, error rate dropped back to baseline. Canary p95 stabilizing. Leaving the train open; rollback plan moved to tombstone unless regression returns. Great catch everyone. :tada:

priya: Merging the cherry-pick to release branch in 5.

sam: Bumping reviewers on #1287 again — if merged we'll schedule a canary re-run later today. Thanks all!
